> > mi le cukta cu lebna la djan gi'e jarco la susan gi'e dunda la alis 
> > "I took the book from John, showed it to Susan, and gave it to Alice." 
> 
> I agree. The more specific defs "x1 shows property x2 to x3" and "x1 shows 
> his x2ness to x3" can be implemented with lujvo.

The definition of {dunda} includes the comment: "x2 may be a specific 
object, a commodity (mass), an event, or a property" and {lebna} 
has "x2 (object/property)", so for {jarco} a property in x2 would 
not be especially odd, as long as it is not restricted to properties 
only.

mu'o mi'e xorxes
